regulatory_descriptor: A Unit-Linked Non-Participating Individual Life Savings Insurance Plan
variants: Bajaj Life Invest Protect Goal Plus - Elite Variant (ULIP base, UIN 116L215V01)
Bajaj Life Secure Plus - Shield with ROP Variant (health component, UIN 116N216V01)
key_benefits: Death Benefit — higher of Prevailing Sum Assured or Regular Premium Fund Value, plus Top-up component, plus Terminal Illness with Term Booster cover; not less than 105% of Total Premiums Paid (Guaranteed Benefit)
Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) — additional payout (higher of ADB Sum Assured or 105% of premiums for that cover) on accidental death
Accidental Total Permanent Disability (ATPD) benefit — lump sum on accidental TPD
Terminal Illness with Term Booster — accelerated cover (paid on TI diagnosis, then cover terminates)
Return of Premiums (ROP) at maturity — premiums paid towards ADB, ATPD and TI-with-Term-Booster are returned at maturity (under Secure Plus - Shield with ROP variant)
Maturity Benefit — Fund Value at maturity plus the returned protection premiums

Loyalty Advantages — Guaranteed Wealth Booster (premium allocation charges accrued at 7% p.a. added at end of 15th year), Return of Mortality Charge (ROMC), Loyalty Additions (from 10th year), Benefit Enhancer (PT >= 25 years)
riders_available: Bajaj Life Secure Plus - Shield with ROP Variant (Non-Participating, Non-Linked, Individual Health Plan, UIN 116N216V01) — the ROP/protection component bundled in this leaflet

eligibility.policy_term: Illustration uses a 30-year policy term with 10-year PPT; full PT range not captured in this parse
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Single / Limited / Regular (illustration uses 10-year limited pay); full range not captured in this parse
eligibility.note: This is a packaged offering: a ULIP base (Invest Protect Goal Plus - Elite, 116L215V01) combined with a health component (Secure Plus - Shield with ROP, 116N216V01). Eligibility boundary table not recovered from this leaflet parse — verify against both policy documents.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document; on cancellation, units are repurchased at the unit price on the date of cancellation and refund is subject to proportionate risk premium, expenses and stamp duty. Processed within 7 days.
key_terms.grace_period: Not explicitly captured in this leaflet parse — verify against policy document.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not explicitly captured in this leaflet parse — verify against policy document.
key_terms.lock_in_note: Unit-Linked products offer NO liquidity during the first 5 years — no full or partial surrender/withdrawal permitted until the end of the fifth year.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits subject to prevailing tax laws; GST and cess apply to all charges. Returns shown at 4% and 8% are illustrative and not guaranteed.

mandatory_disclosures_present: ULIP market-risk statement ('ULIPs are different from traditional insurance products and are subject to risk factors; premium is subject to investment risks; NAV may go up or down; insured is responsible for his/her decisions')
Risk Factors & Warning Statements (product name does not indicate quality/future prospects/returns)

claims_marketing_must_support: Any 'return of premium / get back all premiums' claim is bounded — ONLY the premiums paid towards Accidental Death, ATPD and Terminal-Illness-with-Term-Booster are returned at maturity (under the Secure Plus - Shield with ROP variant); the ULIP fund itself is market-linked, not a guaranteed return.

Any 'guaranteed' wording (Guaranteed Wealth Booster 7% p.a., Guaranteed Benefit 105% of premiums, Return of Mortality Charge) is condition-bound: applies only while the policy is in force and NOT if surrendered, discontinued or paid-up.
Death Benefit '105% of Total Premiums Paid' is a floor (Guaranteed Benefit), not a projected return.
Terminal Illness with Term Booster is an accelerated (not additional) cover — paying it terminates that cover.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT advertise 'guaranteed returns' or 'assured market growth' — the fund value is subject to investment/market risk borne entirely by the policyholder; NAV may go up or down.
Do NOT show only the 8% (or any single) illustrative return as if it were promised — must present both 4% and 8% as illustrative and not guaranteed, and state they are not upper/lower limits.
Do NOT imply liquidity in the first 5 years — there is a mandatory 5-year lock-in with no surrender/withdrawal.
Do NOT state 'tax-free' without the prevailing-tax-law caveat.
must_state: Plan (ULIP) UIN 116L215V01 and, where the ROP/protection component is referenced, health-component UIN 116N216V01
